Question 21(c) [4 marks]: Recommend ways that packaging could be used to maximise sales of the products.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A producer of gourmet ice-creams chooses selective distribution for her products.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Provides reasons in favour of ways the producer can use packaging to maximise sales of her products
3 marks: Provides characteristics and features of how the producer can use packaging to maximise sales
2 marks: Sketches in general terms packaging that the producer can use
1 marks: Provides some relevant information about packaging

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The producer should ensure that her packaging is bright and differently coloured from similar products so that her ice-creams are easily recognisable and stand out from competitors when on display to boost sales. She could make sure that her packaging is made of environmentally friendly material. This would improve her sales by ensuring that she has a good reputation among consumers.

Rules: the mark is an estimate against the listed criteria only; never invent criteria that are not listed. Quote the student's own words as evidence for every mark you award. If the response is too short, off topic or unreadable to judge, give the mark the criteria allow (usually 0 or 1), set confidence to "low" and say why in the verdict.
